name: GitHub Copilot in VS Code (Local agent)
Hand-made chatbot: bare
about: A system prompt and a chat loop around a model API. History lives in memory for the session.

name: Hand-made chatbot: with tools
about: The bare chatbot plus function calling: a few tools the model can call, and request logs.

name: Hand-made chatbot: RAG
about: A chatbot that answers from your documents: an index, a search step before each answer, and saved conversations.

name: Hand-made chatbot: production service
about: A chatbot run for other people: users sign in, sensitive data is involved, and it's deployed, monitored and evaluated.

name: Example: a first CLAUDE.md
about: Not a real harness. Day one on Claude Code: a CLAUDE.md, a lockfile, the built-in web tools, and a few things started (a skill, a permission rule, a test command).

name: Example: a solo project, set up
about: Not a real harness. One person's project after a few weeks: instructions per folder, skills and commands, an MCP server, plan mode, permission rules, tests it runs, a task list and a codebase map.

name: Example: a team repo with guardrails
about: Not a real harness. A shared repo: a team plugin, review before merge, blocking hooks, a sensitive data guard, a completion check that runs the tests, an independent reviewer, a decision log and an event log.

name: Example: guarded unattended runs
about: Not a real harness. A team repo that also runs on its own: sandboxed, with network and spend limits, human approvals for what matters, evals and a feedback loop, receipts and telemetry.

name: Example: every piece in place, hardened
about: Not a real harness. A Claude Code harness with every piece Free Rein knows in place, every one hardened: the top of the scale. In a real harness a piece hardens when it blocks on its own, or when a safeguard guards it; an example can simply say so.
